newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gunfire between street vendors leaves 12 hurt.
newsitem.headline: Gunfire between street vendors leaves 12 hurt.

text.p: At least 12 street vendors were injured on Sunday when gunfire broke out in a turf war squabble, Mexican news agency Notimex reported.
A local hospital official said four of the vendors were in serious condition from bullet wounds.
The vendors also burned 10 vehicles carrying goods in the usually peaceful colonial town about 60 miles (96 km) southeast of Mexico City.
